reason: A is more decisive because it connects oxide chemistry to growth and thermal-mismatch stresses—the unresolved cracking/spallation mechanism—and proposes residual-stress and scale-integrity measurements under controlled cycling. Its treatment of Al2O3 and especially SiO2 as having near-unity Pilling–Bedworth ratios and CTE compatibility is questionable, but B is more generic and contains the less sound claim that Mn oxides have lower thermodynamic stability while not directly testing the proposed stress mechanism.
